## Result

Describe the problem or issue addressed and the resulting behavior. For a
new solution, identify the notebook edition, problem number, source, exact
answer, and any scope limitation.

## Changes

Summarize the proof, documentation, or tooling changes. For a new solution,
link its README and public endpoint, and identify contributors and sources.

## Validation

Report the checks actually run and their results. For proof changes, include
the full Lean build and guarded axiom audit; for changed generated sources,
include the certificate reproduction comparison. For documentation or tooling
changes, include the repository check and any relevant targeted checks.
